answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The mirror graph is validated at intake and the copper frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and walnut anchors the chain at a checkpoint. An attacker who wants 19 percent of the vote must hold 10 percent of the bonded float for 40 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
